Read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/query-data-items and locate an example by its exact title to get it complete. --- Code Example: Query existing items with filter, sort, paging, projection and total count calculation --- ### Query existing items with filter, sort, paging, projection and total count calculation ```javascript curl -X POST \ 'https://www.wixapis.com/wix-data/v2/items/query' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -d '{ "dataCollectionId": "cities", "query": { "filter": { "state": "California" }, "sort": [ { "fieldName": "population", "order": "ASC" } ], "paging": { "limit": 2 }, "fields": ["population"] }, "returnTotalCount": true }' ``` --- Method Response Shape --- ## Method Response Shape ```json { "dataItems": [ "object" ], "pagingMetadata": { "count": "integer", "offset": "integer", "total": "integer", "tooManyToCount": "boolean", "cursors": "object" } } ``` --- Code Example: Query existing items --- ### Query existing items ```javascript curl -X POST \ 'https://www.wixapis.com/wix-data/v2/items/query' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -d '{ "dataCollectionId": "cities", "query": { "filter": { "state": "California" }, "paging": { "limit": 2 } } }' ``` --- Method Description --- ## Method Description: Retrieves a list of items, on the basis of the filtering, sorting, and paging preferences you provide. Choose between offset and cursor paging: - Use `query.paging` (offset) when each request needs its own `filter` or `sort`, or when you need `returnTotalCount`. - Use `query.cursorPaging` to continue an existing result set by reusing the cursor returned in `pagingMetadata.cursors`. Define `filter` and `sort` on the first request only — follow-up cursor requests should pass only the returned cursor, because `filter` and `sort` are ignored on subsequent cursor requests. For date and datetime fields, write filter values as `{"$date":"2026-05-05T00:00:00.000Z"}` (plain ISO 8601 strings are also accepted). To inline related items in each result, set `includeReferences`. If a reference or multi-reference field can contain more items than you want to inline, page the base query first and then call [Query Referenced Data Items](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-solutions/cms/data-items/query-referenced-data-items) for the specific item and field you want to expand. Learn more about [API Query Language](https://dev.wix.com/api/rest/getting-started/api-query-language). ## Method Permissions: WIX_DATA.QUERY ## Method Permissions Scopes: Read Data Items: SCOPE.DC-DATA.READ ## Additional Method Code Examples --- Code Example: HTTP request example --- ... example body omitted under the current line budget — listed under "Available request examples"; read the full doc with its exact title for the complete example ... > Next: read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/query-data-items using the suitable read tool to get the complete code examples and method description. > If you need more detail about the request or response shape, read the full method schema using the suitable tool. > Query/search: this endpoint declares which fields it can filter and sort by, and with which operators. Developer Preview

If you are building a Wix app, add a [data collections extension](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/extensions/backend-extensions/data-collections/about-data-collections-extensions) to automatically enable the code editor and create data collections when your app is installed on a site. The Data Collections API enables you to [create](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/data-collections/create-data-collection), [delete](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/data-collections/delete-data-collection), and [modify](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/data-collections/patch-data-collection) the structure of data collections in a site. ## Use cases + [Set up a tutorials collection with references to collections for categories and authors.](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/data-collections/sample-flows) + [Add draft/publish functionality to a collection.](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/data-collections/sample-flows) ## Data collections and their structure Wix sites store data in collections. A collection determines the structure of the data to be stored, defining the fields each item contains, and the data type of each field. Wix users can [create and modify collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/content-manager-creating-a-collection) for their site using the Content Management System (CMS). > **Note:** > In addition to user-created collections, some Wix business apps automatically create and manage CMS collections on the site. To learn about these, see [Wix App Collections](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/wix-app-collections/introduction). With the Data Collections API, you can use code to create, modify, and delete collections in a Wix site. You can then store and retrieve data in these collections using the [Data Items API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/introduction). > **Note:** > The structure you define for a data collection isn't enforced. This means that if you add or update an item containing a field or data type that doesn't match the collection's structure, your data is stored anyway. ... 19 more lines ... > Next: read the full article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/collection-management/data-collections/introduction using the suitable read tool. --- #### [com.wixpress.cloud.data.api.data.DataItemService.BulkUpdateDataItems](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/bulk-update-data-items) # Package: cms # Namespace: dataItems # Method: Bulk Update Data Items # Method link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/bulk-update-data-items # Method API Endpoint: POST https://www.wixapis.com/wix-data/v2/bulk/items/update ## Method Code Examples ### Available request examples - Update multiple items: Check item revision numbers to guarantee data integrity. - Update multiple items conditionally: Only update cities with at least 1M residents. - Bulk update existing items and return updated items - Bulk update existing items - HTTP request example > These are the request examples found in this result. Read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/bulk-update-data-items and locate an example by its exact title to get it complete. --- Code Example: Update multiple items: Check item revision numbers to guarantee data integrity. --- ### Update multiple items: Check item revision numbers to guarantee data integrity. ```javascript curl -X POST \ 'https://www.wixapis.com/wix-data/v2/bulk/items/update' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -d '{ "dataCollectionId": "cities", "dataItems": [ { "id": "40877d18-c5fe-4ed5-b495-d84bb4c027bd", "data": { "state": "California", "year": 2022, "city": "Los Angeles", "population": 3800000, "revision": 12 } }, { "id": "6c38b4f7-7b8d-4702-9283-66a5889f8e17", "data": { "state": "California", "year": 2022, "city": "San Francisco", "population": 840000, "revision": 14 } } ... snippet cut here — INCOMPLETE example, do not use as-is; read the full doc for the complete example ... ``` ... 29 more lines ... --- Method Response Shape --- ## Method Response Shape ```json { "results": [ "object" ], "bulkActionMetadata": { "totalSuccesses": "integer", "totalFailures": "integer" } } ``` --- Code Example: Update multiple items conditionally: Only update cities with at least 1M residents. --- ... example body omitted under the current line budget — listed under "Available request examples"; read the full doc with its exact title for the complete example ... --- Method Description --- ## Method Description: Updates multiple items in a collection. Call this method when you need to replace the full payload of multiple existing items in one call. For different behavior, you can call: - [Bulk Patch Data Items](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-solutions/cms/data-items/bulk-patch-data-items) to apply partial changes that keep unmentioned fields unchanged. - [Bulk Patch Data Items](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-solutions/cms/data-items/bulk-patch-data-items) with `action: INCREMENT_FIELD` for atomic numeric increments or decrements, such as stock-count deltas. Don't try to express deltas with Bulk Update — replacing the full payload forces a client-side read-then-write that isn't atomic and produces incorrect results under concurrent writers. - [Save Data Item](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-solutions/cms/data-items/save-data-item) per item for upsert behavior, when some IDs may not exist yet. This method replaces each specified data item's existing data with the payload provided in the request. Each item in the request must include an ID. If an item is found in the specified collection with the same ID, that item is updated. If the collection doesn't contain an item with that ID, the update fails. When an item is updated, its `data._updatedDate` field is changed to the current date and time. > **Note:** > After each item is updated, it only contains the fields included in the request. If the existing item has fields with values and those fields > aren't included in the updated item, their values are lost. ## Method Permissions: WIX_DATA.BULK_UPDATE ## Method Permissions Scopes: Write Data Items: SCOPE.DC-DATA.WRITE ## Additional Method Code Examples --- Code Example: Bulk update existing items and return updated items --- ... example body omitted under the current line budget — listed under "Available request examples"; read the full doc with its exact title for the complete example ... --- Code Example: Bulk update existing items --- ... example body omitted under the current line budget — listed under "Available request examples"; read the full doc with its exact title for the complete example ... --- Code Example: HTTP request example --- ... example body omitted under the current line budget — listed under "Available request examples"; read the full doc with its exact title for the complete example ... > Next: read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/bulk-update-data-items using the suitable read tool to get the complete code examples and method description. > If you need more detail about the request or response shape, read the full method schema using the suitable tool. --- #### [com.wixpress.cloud.externaldatabasespi.v3.ExternalDatabaseService.UpdateDataItems](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/external-databases/external-database-service-plugin/update-data-items) # Package: externalDatabases # Namespace: externalDatabaseServicePlugin # Method: Update Data Items # Method link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/external-databases/external-database-service-plugin/update-data-items # Method API Endpoint: POST {DEPLOYMENT-URI}/v3/items/update ## Method Code Examples ### Available request examples - Update multiple data items - Update a single item in a collection > These are the request examples found in this result. Read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/external-databases/external-database-service-plugin/update-data-items and locate an example by its exact title to get it complete. --- Code Example: Update multiple data items --- ### Update multiple data items Updates two data items in a collection. One update fails while the other succeeds. ```javascript curl -X POST https://external-db.example.com/v3/items/update \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -d '{ "collectionId": "cities", "items": [{ "_id": "c285e77c-a86b-4361-a55f-c6b934d70187", "name": "New York", "_owner": "facda016-24ef-4909-a90e-70687f17f658" }, { "_id": "e831385d-d067-4905-a98a-456f5a526ca2", "name": "Paris", "_owner": "facda016-24ef-4909-a90e-70687f17f658" }] }' ``` --- Method Response Shape --- ## Method Response Shape ```json { "results": [ { "oneOf": [ "result" ] } ] } ``` --- Code Example: Update a single item in a collection --- ### Update a single item in a collection ```javascript curl -X POST https://external-db.example.com/v3/items/update \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json;charset=UTF-8' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -d '{ "collectionId": "cities", "items": [{ "_id": "c285e77c-a86b-4361-a55f-c6b934d70187", "name": "New York", "_owner": "facda016-24ef-4909-a90e-70687f17f658" }] }' ``` --- Method Description --- ## Method Description: Updates one or more items in a collection. Items must be completely replaced. The response array must include the same items that were updated, and each returned item must be added the `_createdDate` and `_updatedDate` fields. ## Method Permissions: ## Method Permissions Scopes: ## Method Schema Summary: The `updateDataItems` method is a POST request to `{DEPLOYMENT-URI}/v3/items/update` that updates one or more items in a collection. It requires the `collectionId` (GUID of the collection) and `items` (an array of at least one item to update). The response will contain a `results` array, where each element is either the updated `item` or an `error` object detailing any issues. **Questions and Answers:** 1. **What is the purpose of the `updateDataItems` method?** The `updateDataItems` method is used to update one or more items within a specified collection. 2. **What parameters are required for the `updateDataItems` method?** The `collectionId` and `items` parameters are required for this method. 3. **What is the expected format for the `items` parameter?** The `items` parameter should be an array containing at least one item to be updated. 4. **What information is returned in the response of the `updateDataItems` method?** The response includes a `results` array, which contains either the updated item or an error object for each item processed. 5. **What fields are added to the updated items in the response?** The `_createdDate` and `_updatedDate` fields are added to each item returned in the response. > Next: read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/external-databases/external-database-service-plugin/update-data-items using the suitable read tool to get the complete code examples and method description. > If you need more detail about the request or response shape, read the full method schema using the suitable tool. --- #### [business-solutions/cms/data-items/introduction](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/introduction) ## Resource: Introduction ## Article: Introduction ## Article Link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/cms/data-items/introduction ## Article Content: # About the Data Items API > **Note for app developers:** Wix Data APIs require the site's [code editor](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/get-started/development-environments) to be enabled. The Data Items API allows you to access and manage items in a Wix site's data collections. With the Data Items API, you can: - Create and manage data items in a site's collections. - Publish and unpublish data items through an editorial draft lifecycle. - Retrieve data items from a collection individually or with filtering and sorting queries. - Create and manage reference fields. - Update or remove many items asynchronously by filter. - Perform aggregations and calculations on data in collections. - Run advanced aggregation pipelines for complex data transformations. - Truncate a data collection, removing all its contents.
